manual_review: Complete. Expectations were hand-authored by Team 12 from the object definitions in scripts/build_shared_fixtures.py and the audit policy in ref/phase3.md, then cross-checked against tester/suite/pod_rules.py. A two-member Team 12 review of these expectations and a manual Excel open of clean.xlsx and seeded_issues.xlsx (no repair prompt) were recorded complete on 2026-10-17. Seven seeded rows depend on pod-pending policy (profile team9-defaults-1.0.0, not yet pod-approved); see README.md, 'Policy-dependent rows'. The ten fixtures added on 2026-10-31 (unicode, repeated_ids, multiple_drawings and the seven rejected files zip_traversal through protected_structure) have not been reviewed or opened in Excel yet. An accepted entry without limitations_required expects an empty limitations array.

clean.notes: Sheets Budget (sheetId 1, sheet1.xml) and Notes (sheetId 2, sheet2.xml). Budget's drawing1.xml holds Picture 1 (id 2), Rectangle 2 (id 3) and Chart 3 (id 4), each with a nonblank title and description and no decorative marker.

seeded_issues.notes: Sheet names do not match part numbers: Expenses (sheetId 1) is sheet1.xml, Sheet1 (sheetId 2) is sheet2.xml, hidden ' Sheet03 ' (sheetId 5) is sheet3.xml, Sheet0 (sheetId 4) is sheet4.xml. Shapes carry visible labels and the chart a visible title; these do not substitute for alt text. Per-object intent is listed in tester/fixtures/shared/README.md.

unicode.notes: Six sheets. 'Café costs' (NFD, sheetId 1) holds drawing1.xml: id 2 descr is only U+200B and id 6 title is only U+FEFF (neither is White_Space, so both count as present); id 3 title, id 4 descr and id 7 descr are White_Space only; id 5 has non-ASCII title and descr. '　Sheet2　' trims to Sheet2. 'Sheet３' (fullwidth digit) and 'ſheet4' (long s) do not match the ASCII pattern. '📊 Summary' (drawing2.xml) sorts after 'ｾｰﾙｽ' (drawing3.xml) by code point, though not by UTF-16 unit. Per-object intent is in README.md.

repeated_ids.notes: Expenses (drawing1.xml) repeats id 2 on two top-level pictures and id 4 on a group and its child picture; those four objects take #xml= targets and must be disclosed as limitations (wording is not compared). Rectangle 3 (id 3) and the group's second child (id 5) are unique. Receipts (drawing2.xml) reuses id 2 in another part, which is not a repeat.

multiple_drawings.notes: Summary (sheet1.xml) uses drawing3.xml, Expenses (sheet2.xml) drawing1.xml, hidden 'Hidden costs' (sheet3.xml) drawing2.xml, veryHidden Archive (sheet5.xml) drawing4.xml through an absolute relationship target; Notes has no drawing. Object ids restart at 2 in each part. Each drawing has exactly one object with a missing or whitespace-only field.

corrupt.notes: A ZIP local-file signature followed by plain text; not a readable package. Only status and error envelope are asserted because no error code is agreed.

zip_traversal.notes: Valid one-sheet workbook plus one extra entry named ../outside.xml, a path that leaves the package root. Only status and error envelope are asserted.

zip_duplicate.notes: Valid one-sheet workbook with a second entry at the same path xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml holding different contents. Only status and error envelope are asserted.

xml_dtd.notes: Valid one-sheet workbook whose xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml declares a DOCTYPE with one internal entity (team = "Team 12") and uses it in a cell. No external entity. Only status and error envelope are asserted.

macro_parts.notes: Named .xlsx with the ordinary (non-macro) main content type, but carrying xl/vbaProject.bin with its vbaProject content type and workbook relationship. The part is a compound-file signature plus inert padding; it holds no macro code. Only status and error envelope are asserted.

encrypted_zip.notes: Valid one-sheet workbook with every ZIP entry encrypted using traditional PKWARE (ZipCrypto) encryption and a fixture-only password. Not Office CFB encryption. Only status and error envelope are asserted.

protected_sheet.notes: Valid one-sheet workbook whose worksheet has active protection (sheetProtection sheet="1", real SHA-512 password hash). Workbook structure is not protected. Only status and error envelope are asserted.

protected_structure.notes: Valid one-sheet workbook with locked structure (workbookProtection lockStructure="1", real SHA-512 password hash). No worksheet protection. Only status and error envelope are asserted.
